python.name: Python SDK
python.text:
Using the Daytona Python SDK, create a sandbox, run `echo hello-from-ax` inside it, print the output, then delete the sandbox.

The `daytona` Python package is already installed from the build under test. Do not install or upgrade it from PyPI. Docs: https://www.daytona.io/docs/en/python-sdk/
Credentials are in the environment variables DAYTONA_API_KEY and DAYTONA_API_URL. When done, print the command output and confirm the sandbox was deleted.
